n658c0708cb.headline: Ministry of Finance. The main drivers of Armenia's economic growth in 2022 may become construction and industry
n658c0708cb.summary: Armenia's Finance Minister expects construction and industry sectors to be the main drivers of economic growth in 2022, with inflation returning to permissible limits.
n658c0708cb.why: Sectoral growth in construction and industry signals economic recovery and investment opportunities in Armenia, relevant for regional investors and policymakers.

nf388adb3af.headline: The government plans 7 percent economic growth for 2022 with 'hope for more'
nf388adb3af.summary: The Armenian government projects 7% economic growth for 2022, up from a 6% forecast for 2021.
nf388adb3af.why: Economic growth projections guide investor expectations and government policy in Armenia, impacting fiscal and monetary decisions.
